query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(l.ZDATA, r.ZIMAGEDATA) AS "photo_data: Vec<u8>",
            r.ZIMAGETYPE AS image_type
        FROM ZABCDRECORD r
        LEFT JOIN ZABCDLIKENESS l ON l.ZOWNER = r.Z_PK AND l.ZISPRIMARY = 1
        WHERE r.Z_ENT = 22
          AND lower(r.ZUNIQUEID) LIKE lower(?1) || '%'
        LIMIT 1
